input.rationale: There is no insurance clause anywhere in the Agreement: the only occurrence of "insurance" is a pass-through of taxes, customs, duties and insurance charges payable by Licensee (p0051), and the General Provisions article (p0144-p0159) runs from governing law to representation by counsel with no insurance covenant. Licensor owns and operates the E-Path FX Trading Platform through which our market data and Spot FX trading activity is routed, so it touches our data and an uninsured position sits in walk-away territory. We have inserted the shortest clause meeting the fallback checklist - E&O of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of at least USD 2,000,000 - as new General Provisions subsection (l), and have not volunteered the preferred CGL, workers' compensation or certificate mechanics.

ops.text: INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though Licensor operates the trading Platform and handles our trading data, so we have added our fallback position: professional liability (E&O) of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability of at least USD 2,000,000.
proposal.summary: Insert fallback insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M) in General Provisions

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
